parameters.content:
## Business events
The backend posts every important event here (new enquiry, visit confirmed, project created, payment recorded, invoice issued, ticket, morning brief, payroll summary). The webhook responds only after all enabled steps finish. Failures return an error so the backend retries. Every event includes a stable eventId and Idempotency-Key: connected systems must deduplicate before applying effects. A timeout after partial success can replay earlier steps. Email delivery is not exactly-once.

Add your own steps after **Format event**: email the owner, append a row to Google Sheets, post to Slack/Telegram, or call your CRM. Two disabled examples are included — add credentials, then enable them.
